name: Hermes Agent
description: Runs a self-improving personal agent from a terminal TUI or a Telegram/Discord/Slack gateway, creating its own skills, searching past sessions, and scheduling unattended tasks.

skills.name: Autonomous Skill Creation
skills.description: Generates reusable skills from completed complex tasks and refines them during later use, following the agentskills.io open standard.

skills.name: Multi-Platform Messaging Gateway
skills.description: Runs one gateway process serving Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and email with cross-platform conversation continuity.

skills.name: Scheduled Automation Runs
skills.description: Schedules recurring natural-language tasks with a built-in cron scheduler and delivers results to any connected messaging platform.

skills.name: Parallel Subagent Delegation
skills.description: Spawns isolated subagents with their own conversations and terminals, plus Python RPC scripts that collapse multi-step pipelines.

skills.name: Cross-Session Memory Search
skills.description: Searches past conversations using SQLite FTS5 with LLM summarization and curates persistent memory through periodic self-nudges.
